planets.name: HIP 29442 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-469 with a 6.43-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: HIP 29442 d was found in 2023 by Paranal Observatory as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-469. Its orbit and size follow Egger et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
